prompt:
A family sofa on a Sunday afternoon in a 1980s Indian home: a folded newspaper, two cups of tea, cushions, a cooler in the window, the TV off in the corner. Painted like a 1980s Indian family-magazine illustration in flat gouache: warm teak browns, faded teal and cream with one signal orange, soft grain, nostalgic Sunday light. Wide panoramic composition: the main subject sits in the left third of the frame. Towards the right the same scene carries on, quieter and darker: open sky, distance and shadow, nothing important there, one continuous picture with no panels and no split. Full-bleed edge to edge, no border, no frame, no people, no faces, no hands. No text, no letters, no numbers, no words, no logos, no badges, no religious symbols, no writing anywhere.
